mapper.select: SELECT UC.ISSUE_NO, UC.COUPON_NO, C.COUPON_NAME, C.DISCOUNT_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, C.MAX_DISCOUNT_PRICE, C.MIN_ORDER_PRICE, TO_CHAR(UC.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE FROM USER_COUPON UC JOIN COUPON C ON UC.COUPON_NO = C.COUPON_NO WHERE UC.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UC.STATUS = 'UNUSED' AND UC.END_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY C.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_COUPON SET STATUS = 'USED', USED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE ISSUE_NO = #{issueNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_COUPON ( ISSUE_NO, USER_ID, COUPON_NO, STATUS, CDATETIME, END_DATE ) SELECT USER_COUPON_SEQ.NEXTVAL, U.USER_ID, C.COUPON_NO, 'UNUSED', SYSDATE, SYSDATE + C.EXPIRE_DAYS FROM USERS U CROSS JOIN COUPON C WHERE C.COUPON_NO = #{couponNo} AND U.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND U.STATUS != 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_COUPON WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND COUPON_NO = C.COUPON_NO AND STATUS = 'UNUSED' )

INSERT INTO COUPON ( COUPON_NO, COUPON_NAME, DISCOUNT_TYPE, DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, MAX_DISCOUNT_PRICE, MIN_ORDER_PRICE, EXPIRE_DAYS, CDATETIME, NOTI_MESSAGE ) VALUES ( COUPON_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{couponName}, #{discountType}, #{discountAmount}, #{maxDiscountPrice}, #{minOrderPrice}, #{expireDays}, SYSDATE, #{notiMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUPON_NO, COUPON_NAME, NOTI_MESSAGE FROM COUPON WHERE COUPON_NO = #{couponNo}

SELECT C.COUPON_NO, C.COUPON_NAME, C.DISCOUNT_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, C.EXPIRE_DAYS, TO_CHAR(C.CDATETIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CDATETIME, C.NOTI_MESSAGE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_COUPON WHERE COUPON_NO = C.COUPON_NO) AS ISSUED_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_COUPON WHERE COUPON_NO = C.COUPON_NO AND STATUS = 'USED') AS USED_CNT FROM COUPON C ORDER BY C.COUPON_NO DESC
SELECT USER_ID FROM USERS WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND STATUS != 'ADMIN'
SELECT U.USER_ID FROM USERS U WHERE U.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND U.STATUS != 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_COUPON UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.COUPON_NO = #{couponNo} )
